<div>
<div># Jenkins 自动触发构建配置手册</div>
<br>
<div>&gt; 适用场景：代码推送到指定分支后自动触发 Jenkins 构建部署，无需手动操作。</div>

<br>
<div>---</div>

<br>
<div>## 目录</div>

<br>
<div>- [方式一：Generic Webhook Trigger + GitHub Actions（当前方案）](#方式一generic-webhook-trigger--github-actions当前方案)</div>
<div>- [方式二：GitHub Webhook 直连 Jenkins（免 GitHub Actions）](#方式二github-webhook-直连-jenkins免-github-actions)</div>
<div>- [方式三：Jenkins Multibranch Pipeline + GitHub Integration](#方式三jenkins-multibranch-pipeline--github-integration)</div>

<br>
<div>---</div>

<br>
<div>## 方式一：Generic Webhook Trigger + GitHub Actions（当前方案）</div>

<br>
<div>### 架构</div>

<br>
<div>```</div>
<div>GitHub (push to uat)</div>
<div>  └─&gt; GitHub Actions (self-hosted runner)</div>
<div>        └─&gt; curl POST → Jenkins Generic Webhook Trigger</div>
<div>              └─&gt; Jenkins Pipeline (build → deploy → notify)</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>### 前置条件</div>

<br>
<div>| 组件            | 要求                                                                          |</div>
<div>|-----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|</div>
<div>| Jenkins 插件    | [Generic Webhook Trigger](https://plugins.jenkins.io/generic-webhook-trigger/) |</div>
<div>| Jenkins 插件    | [Git Parameter](https://plugins.jenkins.io/git-parameter/)                    |</div>
<div>| Jenkins 插件    | [Build User Vars](https://plugins.jenkins.io/build-user-vars-plugin/)         |</div>
<div>| GitHub Runner   | self-hosted runner（标签 `ltp`）                                              |</div>
<div>| 构建工具        | Maven 3 (`M3`)、JDK 17 (`jdk17`)                                             |</div>
<div>| 凭据            | `SRE_LTP_TOKEN`（Jenkins Credentials）                                        |</div>

<br>
<div>### Step 1：配置 Jenkins Pipeline</div>

<br>
<div>在 Jenkins Job 中使用 Declarative Pipeline，核心配置如下：</div>

<br>
<div>#### 1.1 触发器配置（triggers）</div>

<br>
<div>```groovy</div>
<div>triggers {</div>
<div>    GenericTrigger(</div>
<div>        genericVariables: [</div>
<div>            [key: 'ref', value: '$.ref']  // 从 webhook payload 提取分支名</div>
<div>        ],</div>
<div>        token: 'ltp-explore-project-uat',       // 自定义 token，需与 GitHub Actions 中一致</div>
<div>        regexpFilterText: '$ref',</div>
<div>        regexpFilterExpression: 'refs/heads/uat' // 仅 uat 分支触发</div>
<div>    )</div>
<div>}</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>**关键参数说明：**</div>

<br>
<div>| 参数                       | 作用                          | 示例                        |</div>
<div>|----------------------------|-------------------------------|-----------------------------|</div>
<div>| `genericVariables`         | 从 JSON payload 中提取变量    | `$.ref` 提取推送分支        |</div>
<div>| `token`                    | 触发认证 token，每个 Job 唯一 | `ltp-explore-project-uat`   |</div>
<div>| `regexpFilterText`         | 参与正则匹配的变量            | `$ref`                      |</div>
<div>| `regexpFilterExpression`   | 正则表达式，匹配才触发        | `refs/heads/uat`            |</div>

<br>
<div>#### 1.2 构建参数（parameters）</div>

<br>
<div>```groovy</div>
<div>parameters {</div>
<div>    gitParameter(</div>
<div>        name: 'BRANCH',</div>
<div>        type: 'PT_BRANCH_TAG',</div>
<div>        branchFilter: 'origin/(.*)',</div>
<div>        defaultValue: 'origin/uat',</div>
<div>        description: '选择要构建的分支/tag（不选择默认 origin/uat）',</div>
<div>        selectedValue: 'DEFAULT',</div>
<div>        sortMode: 'DESCENDING_SMART',</div>
<div>        useRepository: '.*',</div>
<div>        quickFilterEnabled: true,</div>
<div>        listSize: '5'</div>
<div>    )</div>
<div>    choice(name: 'Deploy_Env', choices: ['uat'], description: '选择部署环境')</div>
<div>    choice(name: 'start', choices: ['true','false'], description: '是否自动重启')</div>
<div>    booleanParam(name: 'MAVEN_API_MODE', defaultValue: false, description: 'Build JAR Only')</div>
<div>}</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>#### 1.3 流水线阶段（stages）</div>

<br>
<div>```</div>
<div>Checkout → Build → Deploy</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>**Checkout 阶段：**</div>
<div>- 浅克隆（`depth: 1, shallow: true`）加速拉取</div>
<div>- 提取 Git 提交者、提交信息、Commit SHA</div>

<br>
<div>**Build 阶段：**</div>
<div>- 注入 `SRE_LTP_TOKEN` 凭据到 `settings.xml`</div>
<div>- 调用 `/data/maven_build-nonprod.sh` 执行 Maven 构建</div>
<div>- 支持 `MAVEN_API_MODE`：`true` 时仅构建 JAR，不部署</div>

<br>
<div>**Deploy 阶段：**</div>
<div>- `MAVEN_API_MODE=true`：跳过部署（SDK/API 模式）</div>
<div>- `MAVEN_API_MODE=false`：调用 `/data/java_deploy-nonprod.sh` 执行部署</div>
<div>- 支持 dev / qa / 默认环境分发</div>

<br>
<div>#### 1.4 构建通知（post）</div>

<br>
<div>```groovy</div>
<div>post {</div>
<div>    success {</div>
<div>        // 调用飞书通知脚本</div>
<div>        sh "python3 /data/notify_lark.py &lt;job&gt; &lt;build_number&gt; &lt;url&gt; &lt;author&gt; &lt;commit&gt; &lt;msg&gt; &lt;user&gt; &lt;env&gt; &lt;branch&gt; success"</div>
<div>    }</div>
<div>    failure {</div>
<div>        sh "python3 /data/notify_lark.py ... fail"</div>
<div>    }</div>
<div>}</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>### Step 2：配置 GitHub Actions</div>

<br>
<div>在仓库 `.github/workflows/` 目录创建工作流文件：</div>

<br>
<div>```yaml</div>
<div># .github/workflows/trigger-jenkins-uat.yml</div>
<div>name: Trigger Jenkins UAT</div>

<br>
<div>on:</div>
<div>  push:</div>
<div>    branches:</div>
<div>      - uat</div>

<br>
<div>jobs:</div>
<div>  trigger-jenkins:</div>
<div>    name: Trigger Jenkins UAT Job</div>
<div>    runs-on: [self-hosted, ltp]</div>
<div>    steps:</div>
<div>      - name: Trigger Jenkins</div>
<div>        run: |</div>
<div>          curl -X POST \</div>
<div>            "https://jenkins.icbc.com/generic-webhook-trigger/invoke?token=ltp-explore-project-uat" \</div>
<div>            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \</div>
<div>            -d '{"ref": "refs/heads/uat"}'</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>### Step 3：新项目适配清单</div>

<br>
<div>为新项目配置时，需修改以下内容：</div>

<br>
<div>| 修改项                   | 位置                             | 说明                                           |</div>
<div>|--------------------------|----------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|</div>
<div>| `token`                  | Jenkins Pipeline `triggers` 块   | 改为项目唯一 token，如 `ltp-&lt;project&gt;-uat`     |</div>
<div>| `regexpFilterExpression` | Jenkins Pipeline `triggers` 块   | 按需修改触发分支                               |</div>
<div>| `url`                    | Pipeline `Checkout` 阶段        | 改为目标仓库 Git 地址                          |</div>
<div>| `defaultValue`           | `gitParameter`                   | 改为默认分支                                   |</div>
<div>| `choices`                | `Deploy_Env`                     | 按需添加部署环境                               |</div>
<div>| `token`                  | GitHub Actions `curl` 命令       | 与 Jenkins 中的 token 保持一致                 |</div>
<div>| `branches`               | GitHub Actions `on.push`         | 改为目标触发分支                               |</div>

<br>
<div>---</div>

<br>
<div>## 方式二：GitHub Webhook 直连 Jenkins（免 GitHub Actions）</div>

<br>
<div>### 架构</div>

<br>
<div>```</div>
<div>GitHub (push event)</div>
<div>  └─&gt; GitHub Webhook (直接 POST)</div>
<div>        └─&gt; Jenkins Generic Webhook Trigger</div>
<div>              └─&gt; Jenkins Pipeline</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>### 优势</div>

<br>
<div>- 无需 self-hosted runner，减少基础设施维护</div>
<div>- 延迟更低（少一跳）</div>
<div>- 配置更简单</div>

<br>
<div>### 配置步骤</div>

<br>
<div>#### 2.1 Jenkins 侧（与方式一相同）</div>

<br>
<div>Pipeline 中的 `triggers` 块保持不变，确保 Generic Webhook Trigger 插件已安装。</div>

<br>
<div>#### 2.2 GitHub 仓库配置 Webhook</div>

<br>
<div>1. 进入仓库 **Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook**</div>
<div>2. 填写以下信息：</div>

<br>
<div>| 字段           | 值                                                                                        |</div>
<div>|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|</div>
<div>| Payload URL    | `https://jenkins.icbc.com/generic-webhook-trigger/invoke?token=ltp-explore-project-uat`   |</div>
<div>| Content type   | `application/json`                                                                        |</div>
<div>| Secret         | （可选）设置 HMAC 密钥验证请求来源                                                       |</div>
<div>| Events         | 选择 **Just the push event**                                                              |</div>
<div>| Active         | 勾选                                                                                      |</div>

<br>
<div>#### 2.3 分支过滤</div>

<br>
<div>分支过滤完全由 Jenkins 侧的 `regexpFilterExpression` 负责。GitHub Webhook 会在每次 push 时发送事件，Jenkins 收到后用正则匹配 `$.ref` 字段，不匹配则忽略。</div>

<br>
<div>#### 2.4 安全加固（推荐）</div>

<br>
<div>```groovy</div>
<div>triggers {</div>
<div>    GenericTrigger(</div>
<div>        genericVariables: [</div>
<div>            [key: 'ref', value: '$.ref']</div>
<div>        ],</div>
<div>        token: 'ltp-explore-project-uat',</div>
<div>        tokenCredentialId: '',        // 或使用 Jenkins Credential 存储 token</div>
<div>        regexpFilterText: '$ref',</div>
<div>        regexpFilterExpression: 'refs/heads/uat',</div>
<div>        silentResponse: true          // 不返回触发详情，防止信息泄露</div>
<div>    )</div>
<div>}</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>如果配置了 Webhook Secret，需在 Jenkins 的 Generic Webhook Trigger 配置中启用 HMAC 验证：</div>

<br>
<div>```groovy</div>
<div>hmacKeyId: 'github-webhook-secret'  // Jenkins Credentials ID</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>#### 2.5 验证</div>

<br>
<div>```bash</div>
<div># 在 GitHub Webhook 页面点击 "Recent Deliveries" 查看投递结果</div>
<div># 或手动测试：</div>
<div>curl -X POST \</div>
<div>  "https://jenkins.icbc.com/generic-webhook-trigger/invoke?token=ltp-explore-project-uat" \</div>
<div>  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \</div>
<div>  -d '{"ref": "refs/heads/uat"}'</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>---</div>

<br>
<div>## 方式三：Jenkins Multibranch Pipeline + GitHub Integration</div>

<br>
<div>### 架构</div>

<br>
<div>```</div>
<div>GitHub (push / PR event)</div>
<div>  └─&gt; GitHub App / Webhook</div>
<div>        └─&gt; Jenkins GitHub Branch Source</div>
<div>              └─&gt; Multibranch Pipeline (自动发现分支)</div>
<div>                    └─&gt; Jenkinsfile (per branch)</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>### 优势</div>

<br>
<div>- 自动发现新分支和 PR，无需为每个分支手动配置 Job</div>
<div>- 天然支持 PR 构建和状态回报</div>
<div>- 分支删除后自动清理 Job</div>
<div>- 更符合 GitOps 理念</div>

<br>
<div>### 前置条件</div>

<br>
<div>| 组件            | 要求                                                                      |</div>
<div>|-----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|</div>
<div>| Jenkins 插件    | [GitHub Branch Source](https://plugins.jenkins.io/github-branch-source/)  |</div>
<div>| Jenkins 插件    | [Pipeline: Multibranch](https://plugins.jenkins.io/workflow-multibranch/) |</div>
<div>| GitHub          | GitHub App 或 Personal Access Token                                       |</div>

<br>
<div>### 配置步骤</div>

<br>
<div>#### 3.1 创建 GitHub App（推荐）或 PAT</div>

<br>
<div>**GitHub App 方式（推荐）：**</div>
<div>1. GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → GitHub Apps → New GitHub App</div>
<div>2. 权限：`Contents: Read`、`Metadata: Read`、`Commit statuses: Read &amp; Write`</div>
<div>3. 生成 Private Key，下载 `.pem` 文件</div>
<div>4. 在 Jenkins 中添加 Credential：`Kind: GitHub App`</div>

<br>
<div>**PAT 方式（简单）：**</div>
<div>1. GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens</div>
<div>2. 权限：`repo`（Full control）</div>
<div>3. 在 Jenkins 中添加 Credential：`Kind: Username with password`（用户名填 GitHub 用户名，密码填 PAT）</div>

<br>
<div>#### 3.2 创建 Multibranch Pipeline Job</div>

<br>
<div>1. Jenkins → New Item → **Multibranch Pipeline**</div>
<div>2. Branch Sources → Add source → **GitHub**</div>
<div>3. 配置：</div>

<br>
<div>| 字段                                 | 值                                                            |</div>
<div>|--------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|</div>
<div>| Credentials                          | 选择上一步创建的凭据                                          |</div>
<div>| Repository HTTPS URL                 | `https://github.com/LiquidityTech/ltp-explore-project.git`   |</div>
<div>| Behaviours                           | Discover branches: All branches                               |</div>
<div>| Build Configuration                  | Mode: by Jenkinsfile / Script Path: `Jenkinsfile`             |</div>
<div>| Scan Multibranch Pipeline Triggers   | Periodically if not otherwise run: 1 minute（兜底轮询）       |</div>

<br>
<div>#### 3.3 仓库根目录放置 Jenkinsfile</div>

<br>
<div>```groovy</div>
<div>// Jenkinsfile（放在仓库根目录）</div>
<div>pipeline {</div>
<div>    agent any</div>
<div>    tools {</div>
<div>        maven "M3"</div>
<div>        jdk 'jdk17'</div>
<div>    }</div>

<br>
<div>    stages {</div>
<div>        stage('Check Branch') {</div>
<div>            steps {</div>
<div>                script {</div>
<div>                    // 仅 uat 分支执行完整流程，其他分支仅构建</div>
<div>                    env.IS_UAT = (env.BRANCH_NAME == 'uat') ? 'true' : 'false'</div>
<div>                    echo "Branch: ${env.BRANCH_NAME}, IS_UAT: ${env.IS_UAT}"</div>
<div>                }</div>
<div>            }</div>
<div>        }</div>

<br>
<div>        stage('Build') {</div>
<div>            steps {</div>
<div>                script {</div>
<div>                    GIT_COMMIT = sh(script: 'git rev-parse HEAD', returnStdout: true).trim()</div>
<div>                    GIT_AUTHOR = sh(script: 'git log -1 --pretty=format:%an', returnStdout: true).trim()</div>
<div>                    GIT_MSG = sh(script: 'git log -1 --pretty=format:%s', returnStdout: true).trim()</div>

<br>
<div>                    withCredentials([string(credentialsId: 'SRE_LTP_TOKEN', variable: 'SRE_LTP_TOKEN')]) {</div>
<div>                        sh """</div>
<div>                        sed -i "s|SRE_LTP_TOKEN|\${SRE_LTP_TOKEN}|g" .github/workflows/settings.xml</div>
<div>                        GIT_COMMIT=${GIT_COMMIT} JOB_NAME=${env.JOB_BASE_NAME} sh /data/maven_build-nonprod.sh</div>
<div>                        """</div>
<div>                    }</div>
<div>                }</div>
<div>            }</div>
<div>        }</div>

<br>
<div>        stage('Deploy') {</div>
<div>            when {</div>
<div>                environment name: 'IS_UAT', value: 'true'</div>
<div>            }</div>
<div>            steps {</div>
<div>                script {</div>
<div>                    withEnv([</div>
<div>                        "GIT_COMMIT=${GIT_COMMIT}",</div>
<div>                        "JOB_NAME=${env.JOB_BASE_NAME}",</div>
<div>                        "Deploy_Env=uat",</div>
<div>                        "GIT_MSG=${GIT_MSG}",</div>
<div>                        "start=true"</div>
<div>                    ]) {</div>
<div>                        sh "sh /data/java_deploy-nonprod.sh"</div>
<div>                    }</div>
<div>                }</div>
<div>            }</div>
<div>        }</div>
<div>    }</div>

<br>
<div>    post {</div>
<div>        success {</div>
<div>            script {</div>
<div>                if (env.IS_UAT == 'true') {</div>
<div>                    sh """</div>
<div>                    python3 /data/notify_lark.py \</div>
<div>                        "${env.JOB_NAME}" "${env.BUILD_NUMBER}" "${env.BUILD_URL}" \</div>
<div>                        "${GIT_AUTHOR}" "${GIT_COMMIT}" "${GIT_MSG}" "auto" "uat" "${env.BRANCH_NAME}" "success"</div>
<div>                    """</div>
<div>                }</div>
<div>            }</div>
<div>        }</div>
<div>        failure {</div>
<div>            script {</div>
<div>                if (env.IS_UAT == 'true') {</div>
<div>                    sh """</div>
<div>                    python3 /data/notify_lark.py \</div>
<div>                        "${env.JOB_NAME}" "${env.BUILD_NUMBER}" "${env.BUILD_URL}" \</div>
<div>                        "${GIT_AUTHOR}" "${GIT_COMMIT}" "${GIT_MSG}" "auto" "uat" "${env.BRANCH_NAME}" "fail"</div>
<div>                    """</div>
<div>                }</div>
<div>            }</div>
<div>        }</div>
<div>    }</div>
<div>}</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>#### 3.4 自动触发机制</div>

<br>
<div>Multibranch Pipeline 通过以下方式感知代码变更：</div>

<br>
<div>1. **GitHub Webhook（推荐）：** GitHub 推送事件通知 Jenkins 立即扫描</div>
<div>   - Webhook URL: `https://jenkins.icbc.com/github-webhook/`</div>
<div>   - Events: `push`, `pull_request`</div>
<div>2. **轮询兜底：** 配置 `Scan Multibranch Pipeline Triggers` 周期性扫描（建议 1-5 分钟）</div>

<br>
<div>---</div>

<br>
<div>## 方案对比</div>

<br>
<div>| 维度         | 方式一：GWT + GH Actions     | 方式二：GWT + GitHub Webhook   | 方式三：Multibranch Pipeline     |</div>
<div>|--------------|------------------------------|--------------------------------|----------------------------------|</div>
<div>| 复杂度       | 中等                         | **最低**                       | 较高（初始配置）                 |</div>
<div>| 依赖         | self-hosted runner           | 无额外依赖                     | GitHub App/PAT                   |</div>
<div>| 分支管理     | 手动配置 token               | 手动配置 token                 | **自动发现**                     |</div>
<div>| PR 构建      | 需额外配置                   | 需额外配置                     | **原生支持**                     |</div>
<div>| 延迟         | ~5-10s（经 GH Actions）      | **~1-2s（直连）**              | ~1-5s                            |</div>
<div>| 安全性       | Runner 网络隔离              | 需暴露 Jenkins 端点            | GitHub App 权限粒度细            |</div>
<div>| 适合场景     | 已有 GH Actions 基础设施     | 简单项目、快速接入             | 多分支开发、PR 驱动工作流        |</div>

<br>
<div>## 推荐选择</div>

<br>
<div>- **已有 self-hosted runner + 少量项目** → 方式一（当前方案）</div>
<div>- **快速接入 / 减少依赖** → 方式二（GitHub Webhook 直连）</div>
<div>- **多分支开发 / 需要 PR 构建 / 新项目** → 方式三（Multibranch Pipeline）</div>

</div>
</div>

</div>

</div>
